title: Research-only active-drainage prescribed-head corrector feasibility without smooth qbot projection
purpose: Test whether the existing serialized real-SWAP research backend can execute an active lagged-drainage prescribed-head corrector when the qbot-only smooth-freatic projection is removed from the corrector, without changing production code or the E6 predictor physics.
execution_contract: Reference corrector is evaluated first from the immutable E6 origin.
If reference status is nonzero, stop and close as bounded component-envelope evidence.
If reference succeeds, evaluate every fixed nonzero offset in fresh process/origin state without adaptive refinement.
Discard every diagnostic candidate; do not commit SWAP state or interface ledger.
gates: Predictor reproduces E6 reference head, u_A and q_u within floating-point tolerance.
Reference prescribed-head corrector returns participant status 0 and a valid mass-complete whole-window candidate.
Reference mass residual absolute value <=1e-10 cm.
Committed authority remains revision/time zero and ledger count zero after diagnostic execution.
characterization_only: admissibility of each fixed nonzero offset
accepted substeps, retries and rejection counters
whether any symmetric valid head pair exists for downstream derivative decomposition
stop_rule: If the reference corrector is not admitted, do not alter drainage tables, corrector flags, tolerances, retry budget or production admission. Record the first failing contract/status and stop.
downstream_if_pass: MAP09A may preregister direct mass decomposition of dStorage/dH, dBottomOut/dH and the non-bottom remainder attributable to active drainage over only the fixed valid MAP09 offsets.
interpretation_rules: This is research-backend capability evidence, not production-owner admission.
Drainage remains lagged per accepted substep; no fully implicit drainage Jacobian is claimed.
A nonzero non-bottom derivative would demonstrate that the MAP03 storage/bottom cancellation was process-specific rather than universal.
forbidden: no change to E6 drainage tables or predictor state
